subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should this privileged action batch be refreshed and approved as one unit, or split into smaller token, Codex, Docker, and CodeQL updates?
rationale: The mechanical defects are clear, but the protected security label and broad privileged execution surface require a human owner to choose the review scope and approve the exact refreshed head.

options.title: Refresh as one batch
options.body: Regenerate on current main, fix all coupled assertions, and have workflow/security owners approve the exact head.

options.title: Split privileged action families
options.body: Create smaller batches for token, Codex, Docker, and CodeQL actions to reduce each supply-chain review surface.

recommendation.title: Refresh as one batch
recommendation.body: Regenerate on current main, fix all coupled assertions, and have workflow/security owners approve the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties him directly to the central workflow guard assertions and CI workflow changed by this batch.
